Iliana Yotova wins runoff to become Bulgaria's first elected female president. November 2, 2026, 6:59 AM EST, The Associated Press
Acting President Iliana Yotova won with 57.6% of the vote; liberal opposition candidate Andrey Gyurov 39.5%, conceded.
Yotova: "I voted for national consensus through dialogue, for institutions that work for citizens"; commitment to a strong European path.
Gyurov: "this is how the Bulgarian citizens have voted"; outcomes "had to be accepted as they stood."
Ursula von der Leyen: "For a strong Bulgaria in a strong Europe."
62-year-old; acting president since January when Rumen Radev stepped down to run for parliament. Inauguration January 22; five-year term. Moscow-friendly Progressive Bulgaria party (131 of 240 seats in April). Opposes additional military aid to Ukraine.
